summary: Cambria County steel Aermotor tower, planned in 1921 as Tower No. 3; the register says built 1921 and removed 1978; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1978, according to the register; no source describes the site today.

events.note: July 1921 item from the Indiana Evening Gazette: Tower No. 3 to be erected near St. Lawrence on land owned by Henry Loidon, covering parts of Cambria and Clearfield counties.
Register gives 1921 as the build year. An August 1921 Forest Leaves report named Saint Lawrence among the first 18 towers to be put up that summer.
Register says the tower was removed in 1978.

notes_for_editor: The register and the 1921 newspaper items agree on the year, but the newspaper items describe plans. Only the register confirms the tower was built and when it came down (1978). The newspaper items are quoted on the Weebly page; the originals (Indiana Evening Gazette, 18 July 1921; Forest Leaves vol. 18, Aug 1921) were not read. The 'Tower No. 3' numbering may not match any register numbering; not resolved. Record coordinates (N 40 41.904, W 078 38.201 per the register) are not checked against any description of the site. No staffing, fire, access or photo information found. Ownership and current condition not established.
